common.linkFallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:

magicLink.subject: Your sign-in link for {{appName}}
magicLink.heading: Sign in to {{appName}}
magicLink.body: Use the link below to sign in as {{email}}. It works once.
magicLink.ignore: If you did not ask to sign in, you can ignore this message. Nothing has changed.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your {{appName}} password
passwordReset.heading: Choose a new password
passwordReset.body: Use the link below to set a new password for {{email}}. It works once.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this message. Your password has not changed.

invite.subject: {{inviter}} invited you to {{brandName}} on {{appName}}
invite.heading: You're invited to {{brandName}}
invite.body: {{inviter}} invited {{email}} to join {{brandName}} on {{appName}} as {{role}}. Choose a password and the account is yours.
invite.ignore: If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this message. No account exists until you accept.

securityChange.subject: Your {{appName}} sign-in details changed
securityChange.heading: Your sign-in details changed
securityChange.body_password: The password of {{email}} was changed from its security page. Every other browser was signed out.
securityChange.body_passwordReset: The password of {{email}} was reset with an emailed link. Every browser was signed out.
securityChange.body_twoFactorEnabled: Two-factor sign-in was turned on for {{email}}.
securityChange.body_twoFactorDisabled: Two-factor sign-in was turned off for {{email}}. Signing in now needs only the password.
securityChange.body_recoveryCodes: New recovery codes were made for {{email}}. The old ones no longer work.
securityChange.warning: If it was not you, reset your password now and tell your administrator.
securityChange.footer: Sent because a security change happened on your account at {{host}}. Security emails can't be turned off.

oauthConnected.subject: {{provider}} was connected to your account
oauthConnected.heading: You can now sign in with {{provider}}
oauthConnected.body: The {{provider}} account {{account}} is connected. You can disconnect it from the same page.
oauthConnected.warning: If this wasn't you, disconnect it and change your password.

oauthDisconnected.subject: {{provider}} was disconnected from your account
oauthDisconnected.heading: You can no longer sign in with {{provider}}
oauthDisconnected.body: The {{provider}} account {{account}} is no longer connected. You can connect it again from the same page.
oauthDisconnected.warning: If this wasn't you, sign in and check your security page now.

passkeyAdded.subject: A passkey was added to your account
passkeyAdded.heading: A passkey was added
passkeyAdded.body: “{{passkey}}” can now sign you in to {{appName}}.
passkeyAdded.warning: If this wasn't you, remove it now and change your password.

passkeyRemoved.subject: A passkey was removed from your account
passkeyRemoved.heading: A passkey was removed
passkeyRemoved.body: “{{passkey}}” can no longer sign you in.
passkeyRemoved.remainingBoth_one: You still have {{count}} passkey and an authenticator app.
passkeyRemoved.remainingBoth_other: You still have {{count}} passkeys and an authenticator app.
passkeyRemoved.remainingTotp: You still have an authenticator app.
passkeyRemoved.warning: If this wasn't you, sign in and check your security page now.

passwordResetPasskeys.subject: Your password was reset
passwordResetPasskeys.heading: Your password was reset
passwordResetPasskeys.body_one: Every session and trusted browser was signed out. Your {{count}} passkey was kept: a password reset only proves you can read this mailbox, so it never removes it. Check it on your security page and remove it if you don't recognise it.
passwordResetPasskeys.body_other: Every session and trusted browser was signed out. Your {{count}} passkeys were kept: a password reset only proves you can read this mailbox, so it never removes them. Check them on your security page and remove any you don't recognise.

passkeysMoved.subject: Your passkeys were removed
passkeysMoved.heading: Your passkeys were removed
passkeysMoved.body: This install now runs at {{account}}, so the passkeys registered for its old address could no longer work and were removed. Add a passkey again from your security page.
passkeysMoved.noApp: Your recovery codes were forgotten with them. Set up a second factor again from your security page.

smtpTest.subject: {{appName}} test message
smtpTest.heading: Your mail server works
smtpTest.body: This message was sent through {{host}} by the Helpdock setup wizard. Receiving it means outgoing email is configured correctly.

outgoingTest.subject: {{brandName}} test message
outgoingTest.heading: Your mail server works
outgoingTest.body: This message was sent through {{host}} from Channels, Outgoing email, in {{brandName}}. Receiving it means replies to customers can go out.

customer.replyMarker: ##- Please type your reply above this line -##
customer.replyHint: Reply to this email to add to your request. Keep the reference in the subject.
customer.autoReplyHint: Reply to this email to add to your request.
customer.autoReplyNote: This is an automatic reply. You receive at most one per request.
customer.footer: You are receiving this because you contacted {{brandName}} support.

acknowledgment.subject: [{{ticket.number}}] We received your message
acknowledgment.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Thanks for writing to {{brand.name}}. Your request is {{ticket.number}} and a member of the {{department.name}} team will reply by email.

To add anything, reply to this email and it joins the same request.

outOfHours.subject: [{{ticket.number}}] We received your message
outOfHours.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Thanks for writing to {{brand.name}}. Your request is {{ticket.number}}. The {{department.name}} team is away right now and will reply by email as soon as they are back.

To add anything, reply to this email and it joins the same request.

assigned.rule: A workflow rule assigned it to you.
assigned.sla: SLA escalation assigned it to you.
assigned.skill_based: Skill-based assignment gave it to you.

body.replied: The contact answered on a ticket assigned to you.
body.mentioned: In an internal note on {{subject}}. Customers never see notes.
body.sla_warning: {{percent}} % of the {{clock}} target is used and the ticket still needs an answer.
body.sla_breached: The {{clock}} target has passed and the ticket still needs an answer.
body.escalated: An SLA step or a rule escalated it to you or your team.
body.snooze_ended: A ticket you snoozed woke up. It is back in your queue.

push.testBody: Browser push works on this browser.

assigned.rule: A rule assigned it to you
assigned.skill_based: Skill-based assignment gave it to you
assigned.sla: SLA escalation assigned it to you

event.escalated_one: Escalated to you or your team

footer.why: You get these because of your notification settings.

transcript.subject: Your chat with {{brandName}} [{{reference}}]
transcript.intro: Here is a copy of your chat with {{brandName}}, as you asked.
transcript.note: This email holds this conversation only. Nothing in it opens your chat.

csat.subject: [{{reference}}] How did we do?
csat.introBy: {{agent}} closed your request {{reference}} today. We would like to know how it went.
csat.intro: Your request {{reference}} was closed today. We would like to know how it went.
csat.question: How would you rate the help you received?
csat.hint: Choose a number to open the survey page with it already selected. You can add a comment there before sending.
csat.note: This link works once and expires in {{days}} days. It is an automatic message; replying to it adds to your request.
